criteria.description: Hosted sync egress is denied until explicit per-project opt-in exists.
criteria.evidence: WP01 focused validation: tests/sync/test_consent_resolver_3030.py, tests/cli/commands/test_sync_commands.py, tests/architectural/test_egress_consent_boundary.py — 94 passed, 2 xfailed.
criteria.notes: Absence of a consent record remains denial.

criteria.description: Consent authority is keyed to stable project identity, not login, machine, shell, environment, or SaaS account alone.
criteria.evidence: WP01/WP02 validation: tests/sync/test_consent_resolver_3030.py and selector/ledger tests — 94 passed, 2 xfailed; 56 passed.
criteria.notes: Global rollout arming is not consent.

criteria.description: Event journal, offline queue, sync state, leases, and acknowledgement state are isolated per project.
criteria.notes: Selection and report surfaces are project-scoped.

criteria.description: Every hosted-sync selector filters by project consent before transmission.
criteria.evidence: WP05/WP06 validation: dispatcher/window/body/history/client consent slices — 132 passed; closure proof — 126 passed.
criteria.notes: Includes interactive, daemon, body upload, history import, tracker, and SaaS client seams.

criteria.description: Rows are not acknowledged, marked delivered, or purged unless the exact owning project consented.
criteria.evidence: WP05/WP06 validation: tests/delivery/test_cross_project_refusal_state_3030.py, tests/delivery/test_body_queue_purge_differential_3030.py, tests/cli/commands/test_sync_purge_3030.py — included in 132-pass and 126-pass slices.

criteria.description: User-facing command/API records explicit opt-in for the current project and shows the project allowed to egress.
criteria.evidence: WP04 focused validation: tests/cli/commands/test_sync_commands.py, tests/cli/commands/test_sync_doctor_consent_health_3030.py, tests/cli/commands/test_sync_report_label_is_a_purge_selector_3030.py, tests/sync/test_sync_status_command.py — 67 passed.
criteria.notes: Opt-in/status UX is explicit and project-scoped.

criteria.description: User-facing command/API revokes hosted-sync eligibility and stops future delivery.
criteria.evidence: WP04 focused validation plus WP06 closure proof, including per-project status and purge-selector checks — 67 passed; 126 passed.
criteria.notes: Opt-out stops future egress without deleting local history.

criteria.description: SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC is a rollout/kill switch only and cannot grant egress consent.
criteria.evidence: WP01 validation: env-as-arming invariant, tests/sync/test_consent_resolver_3030.py and tests/cli/commands/test_sync_commands.py — 94 passed, 2 xfailed.
criteria.notes: The runbook repeats this as an operator rule.

criteria.description: Background daemon startup, discovery, selection, transmission, retry, and acknowledgement enforce the same predicates as interactive sync.
criteria.evidence: WP05/WP06 validation: tests/sync/test_background_body.py, tests/sync/test_background_auth_backoff_3030.py, tests/sync/test_daemon_publish_consent_3030.py — included in 132-pass and 126-pass slices.
criteria.notes: Daemon publish and background body drain fail closed.

criteria.description: Migration from shared machine-global state does not silently admit historical projects.
criteria.notes: Backfill/migration preserves denial for unproven projects.

criteria.description: Rows without trustworthy project identity remain local-only or require explicit resolution.
criteria.evidence: WP03 validation plus WP06 closure proof: identity migration/backfill and incident reproduction slices — 60 passed; 126 passed.

criteria.description: Low-level delivery seams refuse non-consenting project rows even if high-level command gates are bypassed.
criteria.evidence: WP05/WP06 validation: tests/specify_cli/saas_client/test_client_consent_gate_3030.py, tests/sync/tracker/test_saas_client_consent_gate_3030.py, tests/sync/test_history_import_consent_3030.py — included in 132-pass and 126-pass slices.

criteria.description: Two projects on one machine cannot select, transmit, acknowledge, or purge each other’s events.
criteria.notes: This is the explicit two-project/multi-project closure proof.

criteria.description: sync status / sync doctor expose per-project queue and consent state before drain.
criteria.evidence: WP04/WP06 validation: tests/cli/commands/test_sync_status_per_project_3030.py, tests/cli/commands/test_sync_doctor_per_project_3030.py, tests/sync/test_sync_status_command.py — covered in 67-pass and 126-pass slices.
criteria.notes: Operators can see cross-project backlog/consent state.

criteria.description: Closure note for #3262/#585 includes prevention evidence and separates #585 historical remediation.
criteria.evidence: WP06 artifacts: docs/runbooks/hosted-sync-consent-incident.md, contracts/closure-dossier.md, issue-matrix.json, PR #3300 body.
criteria.notes: #585 remains open until the 1,322 already-delivered events receive an approved disposition.

negative_invariants.description: A global rollout flag must not grant project consent.
negative_invariants.evidence: WP01 validation and runbook operator rule.

negative_invariants.description: A refused row or task must not be acknowledged or purged as delivered.
negative_invariants.evidence: WP05/WP06 validation, including cross-project refusal and purge differential tests.

negative_invariants.description: This mission must not close SaaS #585 historical remediation.
negative_invariants.evidence: Closure dossier and runbook explicitly require a separate disposition for the already-delivered 1,322 events.
